subject.title: fix(feishu): add chunk-idle timeout to inbound media download

question: Should Feishu inbound media body-idle handling honor the selected account’s effective HTTP timeout, or intentionally impose a separate fixed 30-second cutoff?
rationale: Both policies are technically possible, but choosing a second fixed cutoff changes the meaning of existing Feishu timeout settings and requires explicit channel-owner intent.

options.title: Reuse the effective account timeout
options.body: Thread the existing validated Feishu timeout into the idle wrapper so configured behavior remains consistent across connection and body-stall handling.

options.title: Approve a separate 30-second policy
options.body: Keep the fixed cutoff only with explicit owner approval, clear upgrade rationale, and proof that supported slow transfers and configured timeout expectations remain acceptable.

options.title: Pause pending transport proof
options.body: Hold the PR until installed Lark SDK or live Feishu evidence establishes the cleanup and recovery behavior before selecting the permanent policy.

recommendation.title: Reuse the effective account timeout
recommendation.body: Thread the existing validated Feishu timeout into the idle wrapper so configured behavior remains consistent across connection and body-stall handling.

likelyOwner.reason: Earlier review and merge involvement on the central Feishu media path makes this the strongest available owner for the compatibility-sensitive policy decision.
